tools.name: ceremony_info
tools.description: Returns where and how a mandate draft becomes an instrument. Minting and revocation are human ceremonies at https://capital.new — agents draft and verify; humans authorize. v1 has no signing rail: signing arrives with the portable credential in a later version.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
